items.title: Charles McPherson interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: In fact it was Thad Jones and Pepper Adams. Barry Harris was playing piano, and Elvin was the drummer... that was the local band.

ctx.x: Wasn’t there Thad Jones and Billy Mitchell and those guys?
Thad Jones also. Billy, that’s right. Thad Jones, Billy Mitchell, Pepper Adams.
